findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_companies, get_company_finances, find_companies, get_related_companies, search_help · Private data: get_company_deadlines, get_company_finances, find_companies, search_help · Public sink: get_related_companies · Destructive: run_company_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_companies, get_company_finances, find_companies, get_related_companies, search_help · Private data: get_company_deadlines, get_company_finances, find_companies, search_help · Public sink: get_related_companies · Destructive: run_company_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
